parsed.headline: Kubernetes Resource Request Verdicts for explainer-lab

cpu.explanation: The CPU request can be decreased from 0.500 cores to 0.010 cores. The candidate request of 0.000 cores is below the minimum floor of 0.010 cores, so the minimum is used instead.

memory.explanation: The memory request can be decreased from 512Mi to 32Mi. The candidate request of 25Mi is below the minimum floor of 32Mi, so the minimum is used instead.
